output.title: Furnished Renovated Studio with Historic Character in Clausen
output.description:
This studio apartment offers 38 m² of efficiently arranged living space within a historic stone building in Clausen. The interior combines rustic and modern elements, featuring exposed wooden beams and wood flooring that reflect the building's character. The living area includes a double bed and is fully furnished for immediate occupancy.

The compact kitchenette has been recently renovated and includes a two-burner cooktop, a compact refrigerator, a small wall cabinet, and a stainless steel sink, providing a functional space for meal preparation. The bathroom also benefits from a recent renovation, with a modern shower stall, compact vanity, and white tiling.

Situated on a narrow street in the Clausen valley, this property enjoys the atmosphere of a historic setting while remaining within reach of the wider city. The exterior of the building is well maintained, preserving its historic appeal.

Modern renovated bathroom with shower stall
Situated on narrow Clausen valley street
